title: Tags
intro: The only tags catalog files may carry, grouped into internal categories. Administrators define each category's name, its tags (a tag belongs to exactly one category), and the entity kinds its tags apply to.
loadFailed: Could not load the tag categories

field.name: Category name
field.nameHint: An internal grouping name — not part of the stored YAML
field.tagsHint: Lowercase [a-z0-9:+#] with dashes — press Enter to add each tag; a tag can belong to only one category
field.kindsHint: Only files of these kinds may carry this category's tags

validation.name: Category name must be 1–63 characters
validation.tag: Tag "{{tag}}" must be 1–63 characters of [a-z0-9:+#] with single dash separators

saveInvalid: One or more fields are invalid
saveGone: This category no longer exists — reload the page

deleteBody: Files carrying "{{name}}" tags will not save until the tags are re-registered or removed from them.
